arguments.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your tap is already logged (ref R-4801) and Swift Plumbing & Heating are booked to visit on Thursday 15 October, 08:00-12:00. I've added your update that it's getting worse and now drips constantly, so we haven't opened a second job. In the meantime, if there's a small valve on the pipe under the sink, turning it a quarter turn clockwise should stop the drip until the visit; put a bowl or towel under the tap if not. If the drip turns into a proper leak or water gets near any electrics, tell us straight away. Is the 15th still OK, or would you like us to ask for an earlier slot? We'll update you by Monday 12 October.
